create_ModularArithmetic_task: create a ModularArithmetic task with a given modulus and optional custom operators
sample_batch_expressions: sample a batch of modular arithmetic expressions with one-hot encoded inputs and labels
evaluate_expression: evaluate a single modular arithmetic expression and return its reduced result
perform_multiplications: perform all multiplications in a modular arithmetic expression and return additive terms
replace_subtractions: replace subtractions in a modular arithmetic expression with additions using modular inverses
